After resolving the withdrawal chains from later records back to earlier ones, only the effective Finance Office budget changes count. Administrative messages and all non-Finance messages contribute zero.

| Component | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Opening budget (#0001) | $1,080K |
| Effective increases | +$28,701K |
| Effective decreases | −$27,364K |
| **Current budget** | **$2,417K** |

Withdrawn changes are excluded rather than subtracted again; changes restored by withdrawals of withdrawals are counted once.

ANSWER: $2417K
